title: Window Pane Icons and Drag Handle
description: All window panes must show icons instead of chevron and have a drag handle. Same as panel toggles.
summary: Window pane chrome now matches panel toggles: fixed semantic icons (settings-2 / play / search / hammer) instead of fold-direction chevrons, plus a trailing DragHandle. Added shared WindowPaneChromeToggle; Pane requires an icon prop and always shows the drag handle (wired when onAnchorChange is set). DragHandle forwards full usePointerDrag pointer handlers.
